why: A delivers every piece in the light, Nordic woods the client asked for: an ash desk, a tall 200 cm birch bookcase for the long white wall, a bentwood rocker and a proper reading lamp. Only the honey-toned, traditional chair is slightly off. B uses a grey-wash desk on a metal base, a short dark espresso ladder shelf that is neither tall nor light wood, and a mesh lounge chair, so the result is less faithful to the request and less cohesive.
